==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])

:[[Energy]] -5
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Greater Dark Scimitar]] [[dye]]d black.
